checks.name: Property-Based State Machine Invariants
checks.summary: 12 invariant properties verified across randomized action sequences
details: all formal invariants hold across arbitrary UI action sequences
filtering by a specific tier never returns tiers outside that selection
pass rate is bounded in [0, 100] for all non-negative passed/failed counts
media project filter always returns only matching project items
ProofDashboard state machine properties
all formal invariants hold after every transition in arbitrary action sequences
toggling any task twice restores the exact original state
clearCompleted removes all completed tasks and preserves every active task in order
adding a blank or whitespace-only task is always a no-op
adding a non-blank task then deleting its assigned id leaves task list unchanged
hydrating arbitrary untrusted storage payloads always produces a valid TodoState
TodoState machine properties
all formal invariants hold across arbitrary sequences of load and addUser actions
adding an already-existing name (ignoring case and surrounding whitespace) is always rejected
